features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE: ONE NEW TABLE AND FIVE SETTINGS, NO DATA REWRITTEN — The update runs by itself one new migration and two of the settings. The new table of the practice's papers starts with a single paper, the «Carta dello studio» (the practice's paper): with fields, with the logo if you upload one and with the usual colours, the paper of every document until you choose another. The print settings get four new fields for the practice (VAT number, tax code, website and logo) and the choice of the paper for each group of documents, empty: the default paper applies. The update rewrites no data and changes no record. Each migration checks by itself what is already there: if it stops halfway it resumes where it got to, and a paper or a choice already written is not touched. Two readings change instead: if the print settings hold the name of the practice, every printout except the F24 form has it at the top; the amount resolved with the instalments of the plans generated before the program kept the detail of the apportionment is rebuilt when it is read (below). No new permission: the papers are managed by whoever manages the settings. No new library; the requirements do not change. After the update, reload the pages already open.

CHANGES: THE PRACTICE AT THE TOP OF EVERY PRINTOUT — If you wrote the name of the practice in «PDF Print Settings», after the update the practice is at the top of every printout of the program, except the F24 form, which belongs to the Revenue Agency; before, only the letter to the residents and the title page of the assembly file had it (the offsetting notice only used its town, for the place). On the first page, on the left, the logo and the practice with its details (the address with the town, VAT number and tax code, telephone, email, certified email and website; an empty detail is not printed), on the right the condominium with its name, address and tax code: whoever receives the sheet reads who wrote it and which condominium it belongs to. From the second page a single line, with the practice and the condominium. The footer is the usual one: the date of issue, the legal note and the page number. In letters, receipts and offsetting notices the practice is at the top left and below it reads «Amministratore del Condominio …» (Administrator of the Condominium …) with street, town and tax code, because the recipient is on the right, with its lines aligned to the right margin; in the receipt the account the payment went into is called «del condominio» (the condominium's), for example «Conto BPER (conto corrente del condominio)»: the resident reads that the money belongs to the condominium, not to the practice. With all the practice's details the first page has less room for the text (about 27 mm in letters); the accounting register and the journal lose at most two rows on their first page, and the general ledger can have one more page. Without the name of the practice the header is the condominium's only, as before.

CHANGES: THE RECIPIENT OF LETTERS, RECEIPTS AND NOTICES ALIGNED TO THE RIGHT — In letters to the residents, receipts and offsetting notices the recipient (the name, the address and, in receipts and notices, «Gentile») has its lines aligned to the right margin, with or without the practice; before, it started 112 mm from the edge of the sheet, where the window of the envelope is. The left column, with the practice or the condominium, wraps at least 8 mm before the recipient's column: a long condominium name no longer comes up against it. Without the practice the condominium's name has the same size as the recipient's name. If you use window envelopes, check with «Prova la carta» where the address falls.

CHANGES: WITHOUT THE PRACTICE THE PRINTOUTS STAY AS BEFORE, EXCEPT FIVE DEFECTS FIXED — Without the name of the practice every printout is the same as before, in text and position, except the header of letters, receipts and offsetting notices (above), these cases and the sentences on the amount resolved with the instalments in the financial summary and on the title page (below). A person's statement of account starts 2 mm lower: its first row ended up under the rule of the header. The overdue instalments («Rate scadute») start 6 mm lower: the rule of the header ran across the title. The general ledger has, from the second page, the line with the condominium, and at the bottom of every page the date of issue, the legal note and the page number, which it did not have: a detached sheet says what it is and which condominium it belongs to. With a condominium name longer than about 55 characters, on the portrait printouts with the common header (the expense sheet, the statement of account, the statement of tenant charges) the header covered the start of the text: now the text starts below it. In the receipt, an account named like its type, or whose name starts with the type, no longer repeats it in brackets: «Conto corrente BPER», not «Conto corrente BPER (Conto corrente)».

CHANGES: THE SIGNATURE AND THE LOGO ARE REWRITTEN WHEN YOU UPLOAD THEM — The signature and the logo are saved rewritten by the program, as PNG, with the long side at most 1,000 pixels and with the transparency they have: a signature or a logo without a background stays without one, even on a coloured letterhead. A photo taken with a phone is turned the way the phone shows it, if the server has PHP's «exif» extension (the Docker installations have it). They are uploaded as PNG or JPG up to 2 MB, or up to the server's limit if it is lower; an SVG, a GIF or a WEBP is refused with a single sentence. An image of more than 4 million pixels (more than 2,000 × 2,000, for example) is refused, with the sentence asking to reduce it: 1,000 pixels on the long side are enough. The signature uploaded before this version is not rewritten by itself: if it is larger than 1,000 pixels, the page says so below the signature and asks you to upload it again, because it weighs on every PDF. When you change the signature or the logo, the new file is saved first and the old one deleted afterwards: if saving fails, the previous ones stay (before, the old signature was deleted first, and could be lost).

CHANGES: THE COMMISSION OF AN EXTRAORDINARY-MANAGEMENT PAYMENT CAN ALSO GO ON AN ORDINARY ITEM — In the supplier-payment form, new and when editing, the «Voce della commissione» field (commission item) offers at the top the items of the payment's management and below them the expense items of the ordinary management of the same financial year, with the management's name beside them. So the € 2.50 of the bank transfer for the works can go, if you wish, on the bank charges of the ordinary management: they enter the final figure of that item, and the payment stays with the management of the invoices. Before, it took two records, the commission at zero and an immediate settlement, and the sentence below the field said so: that sentence is gone. The program accepts an item of another management only if it belongs to an active ordinary management linked to the same financial year, and the refusal says why. The same applies to «Assegna la voce» (assign the item) in the list of commissions without an item. The «Voci e gestione delle fatture» check (items and management of the invoices) looks at invoices, not at commissions: a commission put on the ordinary management is not a «non torna» (does not match).

CHANGES: REVERSING IN THE FOLLOWING YEAR A COMMISSION, AN IMMEDIATE SETTLEMENT OR A PAYMENT FROM A THIRD PARTY — When the reversed record was on an item of a management that the year of the reversal does not have (for example the 2026 ordinary management, if 2027 has its own), the reversal no longer copies that item, which the following year's statement does not read: before, the «I costi tornano con il riepilogo» check (the costs agree with the summary) did not match. Now the row goes without an item, with the same amount and on the same side, and its note names the item of the time: a payment's commission on the program's «Spese bancarie» (bank charges), an immediate settlement or a payment from a third party on its own account. The earlier year stays as it was. In the following year's list of commissions without an item (it is called «Commissioni e storni senza voce», commissions and reversals without an item, when it has the reversal of a settlement or of a payment from a third party), the reversal is assigned to an item of an ordinary management of that year, if the year is open: an expense item for the commission and the settlement, an income item for the payment from a third party, so the item's collected amount goes down. Once assigned, it enters the final figure of the item, in its management. Until it is assigned, the costs check counts it among the explained parts, and the «Sintesi» (summary) and the financial summary lead to the list: from the «Commissioni senza voce» row (commissions without an item) for the reversal of a commission, from «Costi non classificati» (unclassified costs) for the others. The reversal of a record that already had no item stays without one. For the reversal of a payment from a third party the menu does not offer the income items placed under an expense chapter, which the summary does not read.

CHANGES: THE AMOUNT RESOLVED WITH THE INSTALMENTS OF EARLIER PLANS IS REBUILT — For the instalment plans generated before the program kept the detail of the apportionment, the financial summary, the «Sintesi» of the financial statement and the title page of the assembly file no longer just say «non disponibile» (not available): the amount resolved with the instalments («Deliberato con le rate») is rebuilt when it is read, redoing the apportionment with today's data, and it is used only if it matches, to the cent, the plan's shares of every unit. If one plan of the management does not match, the whole management stays «non disponibile», and the page says which plan. The column says «ricostruito» (rebuilt), with a sentence saying where the figures come from and when they can go back to «non disponibile»; where the plan had fixed only the chapter, or no item, the item's figure is divided with today's amounts and carries an asterisk, with the sentence explaining it. A plan with an expense moved from one item to another with «Sposta spesa» (move expense), and not moved back, is not rebuilt: the management stays «non disponibile», and a sentence says why. In the printout of the summary the column says «Deliberato con le rate (ricostruito)», and the sentences sit below the table of their management, in the size of the text, no longer in small print after all the managements: the resident reads the explanation next to the figures. On the title page they sit below the statement. The program writes nothing: the apportionment of earlier plans stays as it was.

CHANGES: THE SUMMARY AND THE FINANCIAL SUMMARY LEAD TO THE LIST ONLY WHEN THERE IS SOMETHING TO ASSIGN — When none of the year's commissions without an item can be assigned (in a closed year, for example), the band in the «Sintesi» says so and leads to the list with «Vedi l'elenco» (see the list), no longer with «Assegna la voce». In the financial summary «Assegna la voce» appears on the «Commissioni senza voce» row (commissions without an item) when the list has some to assign, and on the «Costi non classificati» row when there are reversals to assign. The band of the reversals is there even when two reversals cancel each other out, and with reversals of different signs the band and the costs check also say how many rows there are and the total without the sign.

FIXES: IN THE PORTAL «CONSENTI COMMENTI» NO LONGER MAKES A PRIVATE COMMUNICATION PUBLIC — When editing a communication from the portal, the box that decides whether it is private had the label «Consenti commenti» (allow comments), with the explanation of comments: by unticking it so as not to receive comments, the resident made their private communication visible to the whole building. Now the box says «Crea comunicazione come privata» (create as private communication), with its explanation, as in the form of a new communication; in the two portal forms each label switches on its own box (before, the label of «Comunicazione in evidenza» switched on nothing). The defect was also in 1.11.0; a communication made public this way stays public after the update.

NEW: THE PRACTICE'S PAPERS — In «PDF Print Settings» there is a new section, «Le carte dello studio» (the practice's papers: a paper says how the header of the printouts comes out), and below it «Quale carta per quale documento» (which paper for which document). A paper is with fields, with the practice and the condominium written by the program, or with the practice's letterhead under the portrait printouts; with or without the logo; the headings, their rules and the header in the colour you choose, or in the usual colours. The colour never goes into the text or the figures, and a colour that reads badly on white (a contrast below 4.5 to 1) is refused. The typeface stays the usual one. The «Carta dello studio» is the default: the documents for which you choose no other paper use it. The default cannot be deleted, nor can a paper a group uses: the sentence says which groups. A paper's name is unique, regardless of capitals and extra spaces. In «Quale carta per quale documento» you choose the paper for five groups, each with the list of its printouts (letters to the residents; receipts and offsetting notices; financial statement and assembly; statements of account and statements for the person; registers and lists of the practice), or «La stessa per tutti» (the same for all). «Prova la carta» (try the paper) opens in a new tab a PDF with sample data (a condominium, a recipient and invented figures): a letter, with the place the real letter will have, and a landscape page, with the saved paper.

NEW: THE PRACTICE HAS FOUR MORE FIELDS — In the section «Lo studio, in testa alle stampe» (the practice, at the top of the printouts) there are the VAT number (11 digits), the tax code (11 digits, or 16 letters and digits; saved in capitals and without spaces), the website (without spaces) and the logo. The logo is printed beside the practice's name, at most 14 mm high and 40 mm wide. The practice's town also goes into the header, beside the address, and is not repeated when the address already says it; it stays the place at the top of the letters. After saving, the fields show what the program saved.

NEW: THE PRACTICE'S LETTERHEAD UNDER THE PRINTOUTS — A paper can have the practice's letterhead under the portrait printouts: a PDF of one or two A4 portrait pages (the first page, and the one for the following pages), or an A4 portrait image in JPG at least 1,240 pixels wide, up to 10 MB or the server's limit if it is lower. The program tries the PDF when you upload it, as if it were printing, and saves it redone, with the pages only: the links, attachments and commands inside the PDF do not stay. A printer's letterhead with bleed is trimmed to the A4 sheet when the PDF marks the trimmed size, as PDFs made for the printer usually do; otherwise a page larger than A4 is refused, and the sentence gives its size. A PDF the program cannot read (protected, or saved in a format it does not open) is refused, and the sentence says to upload the letterhead as a JPG image. The image is saved without being rewritten, but without the photo's data (the camera model, the date, the place, the thumbnail), which therefore do not reach the residents with the printouts; a rotated photo is refused (if the server has PHP's «exif» extension; without it, the program does not see that it is rotated), with the sentence asking to turn it and save it again. The paper's margins say where the room for the text is: for a new paper the program proposes 45 mm at the top, 25 at the bottom, 20 left and right; the sides go up to 50 mm, top and bottom together up to 150. On the letterhead the program does not write the practice, which is printed on the paper: it writes the condominium at the top of the free space and the footer just above the bottom margin; in letters, receipts and notices the top left has «Amministratore del Condominio …» with street, town and tax code, and the recipient is on the right, aligned to the paper's right margin. Each letter of a PDF with several letters starts with the first page of the letterhead, and the following pages have the second. The landscape printouts (apportionments, registers, summary, lists) have the fields header of the same paper, with the logo if the paper says «Con il logo» (with the logo). In the assembly file the first page of the letterhead goes to the title page, the portrait parts have the second and the landscape ones the fields header. After the upload the page asks you to open the paper with «Prova la carta» and look at where the condominium, the text and the footer fall. If in printing the letterhead can no longer be read (the file is missing, or the disk does not answer), the printout comes out with fields, with the practice written by the program if the practice has a name, and the settings page says so beside the paper. A paper turned back to fields keeps the file, to go back to the letterhead without uploading it again; «Togli la carta intestata» (remove the letterhead) deletes it when you save. In the letters window, with a letterhead for the letters and without the name of the practice, the sentence says that the letter comes out on the letterhead, no longer that it carries only the condominium.

CHANGES: THE «ONE PDF PER PERSON» .ZIP IS WRITTEN ONE PDF AT A TIME — The .zip of the receipts and that of the letters are written one PDF at a time, into a temporary file on the server that is deleted after the download: the memory holds a single document, not the sum of all of them. With the letterhead, which goes into every PDF, the .zip of the receipts takes up to 200 receipts at a time, as without it.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MATTERS — (1) The footer is the same with every paper (the date of issue, the legal note, the page number), and the signature and the legal note are one for the whole practice; the typeface cannot be chosen. (2) The rebuilt amount reads today's data: if the thousandths, the item amounts (for example with the new year's budget on the same management), the holders or the already-paid change afterwards, it can change or go back to «non disponibile». It is best to print the assembly file first. (3) In the printout of the summary, when the table of a management ends right at the bottom of the page, the sentences about the resolved amount go alone to the top of the next page. (4) The individual expenses of a plan written without an item do not enter the amount resolved with the instalments nor the resolved shares, even if the plan charges them to the units. (5) A PDF letterhead loses its links: the website and the email printed on it stay, but cannot be clicked. (6) The emails of the receipts still close with the condominium's name, those of the offsetting notices with «Cordiali saluti»: not with the practice. (7) A PDF that the program redoes after a change of paper comes out with the new paper; the stored letters, such as the formal notice, stay as they were made. (8) An item given from the «Commissioni e storni senza voce» list cannot be changed or removed there: the row leaves the list. A commission's item is changed by editing the payment (if the payment has several invoices, by reversing and redoing it); a reversal's item cannot be changed today, because a reversal cannot be reversed. (9) An income item created under an expense chapter does not show its collected amount in the financial summary, and the costs check does not match: income items go under an income chapter.
